# OpenHands AI Assistant

This repository is configured with OpenHands, an AI assistant that can help with code reviews, answer questions, and assist with development tasks.

## How to Use OpenHands

### In Pull Requests

OpenHands will automatically review new pull requests and provide feedback.

### In Comments

You can also summon OpenHands in PR comments by using the `/openhands` command. For example:

- `/openhands Please review this code`
- `/openhands Can you explain how this function works?`
- `/openhands Suggest improvements for this implementation`

## Examples

Here are some examples of how you can use OpenHands:

- `/openhands What does this code do?`
- `/openhands Can you help me fix this bug?`
- `/openhands Suggest a better way to implement this feature`
- `/openhands Review my changes and provide feedback`

## Benefits

- Get instant code reviews
- Receive suggestions for improvements
- Get help with debugging issues
- Learn about best practices
